elements.name: is_token_expired_soon
elements.brief: Whether the session's access token expires within the next twenty-four hours.
elements.description:
Whether the session's access token expires within the next twenty-four hours.
Refresh the session while this is true rather than waiting for it to expire.

elements.name: is_token_expired
elements.brief: Whether the session's access token has already expired.
elements.description: Whether the session's access token has already expired.

elements.name: expired
elements.brief: Upstream's backwards-compatible alias of `is_token_expired`, kept because older
elements.description:
Upstream's backwards-compatible alias of `is_token_expired`, kept because older
code calls it. New code should call `is_token_expired`.

elements.name: is_refresh_token_expired
elements.brief: Whether the session's refresh token has expired. A session created without a
elements.description:
Whether the session's refresh token has expired. A session created without a
refresh token counts as expired, there being nothing left to refresh with.

elements.name: create
elements.brief: Builds a session from an authentication response, decoding the tokens it carries
elements.description:
Builds a session from an authentication response, decoding the tokens it carries
to read their expiry, username, user id and session variables.

parameters.name: data
parameters.doc: The authentication response, which must carry a `token`.

elements.name: store
elements.brief: Writes a session to disk under the project title, so it survives a restart.
elements.description: Writes a session to disk under the project title, so it survives a restart.

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: Names the saved session. Defaults to `nakama`.

elements.name: restore
elements.brief: Reads back a session written by `store`.
elements.description: Reads back a session written by `store`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: The name the session was stored under. Defaults to `nakama`.

returnvalues.doc: The stored session, or `nil` if nothing usable was stored under that name.
